meta.title: Overhaul Property Tab and Element Creation with Performance and UX Improvements
meta.body_summary: Overhaul MAUI Designer property tab with caching, sequential processing, and categorized UI; add robust element creation with error handling.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot overhauled property tab with caching and sequential processing; maintainer flagged compilation error, fixed by agent and maintainer, merged quickly with no perf benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 527 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a moderate incremental performance PR that merged after fixing a compilation error.

review_details.concern_detail: GMPrakhar noted duplicate code in ToolBox.cs causing compilation failure and requested compilation check before commits.
review_details.performance_claim: 2-5x improvement in property loading via caching and sequential processing.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: parallel_overhead_and_uncached_reflection (prior Parallel.ForEach and repeated reflection calls; not in taxonomy enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented a property manager with caching but introduced a duplicate code block causing compile failure; maintainer corrected after review.

detection_detail.code_reading: GMPrakhar reviewed the diff in ToolBox.cs and spotted duplicate code causing a compilation error, requesting the project be compiled before submitting changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler evidence provided; performance claim is narrative only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot removed duplicate lines; GMPrakhar also committed a separate fix for compilation issues in other files.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced Parallel.ForEach with sequential foreach in PropertyHelper, added PropertyManager with ConcurrentDictionary caching for reflection, and improved element creation error handling in ElementCreator.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Compilation fixes and minor adjustments were applied to several service files after initial changes.
